class_name: 話題-同類取り立て-モ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1: author → mechanical attachment gate → cold review → fixes applied → gate re-run

patterns.usage_note: Adds an item to something already established, replacing が or を outright and stacking onto other particles instead (にも, からも, までも). With a quantity or an extreme case it shades into "even" (挨拶もしない, 三時間も). Because it displaces the subject and object markers, 私も知っている is right and 私がも is not.

examples.ruby: 弟[おとうと]も来年[らいねん]から東京[とうきょう]で働[はたら]くらしい。
examples.english: My little brother is apparently starting work in Tokyo next year too.

examples.ruby: この薬[くすり]は子供[こども]にも安心[あんしん]して使[つか]えます。
examples.english: This medicine is safe to use on children as well.

examples.ruby: 二階[にかい]の窓[まど]からも花火[はなび]がよく見[み]えるよ。
examples.english: You can get a good look at the fireworks from the upstairs window too.
